reviews.review: I was skeptical at the first, second, and third look. However I was finally coerced into getting the game. I couldn't be happier to be wrong. The game play is still fun after 3 hours straight and I don't really like rogue like games. I even found myself still getting into the music after several hours where most games get that particular slider dropped to 0 within 20 minutes. I'd give it a solid recommendation. Actually, I would insist on anyone picking this up if it went on sale again; it's entirely worth the full price.

It's a pretty fun game. I've logged about 30 hours playing it. I'm hoping some of the glitches get resolved. There are are some skins I've definitely unlocked and the game doesn't enable those skins for me. I wish you could change guns through Legendary chests. The game gets boring using the same gun for 100+ runs. There are also some Biomes that are rock-like where you can get trapped if you jump around too much... which is frustrating.

All-in-all very good game for being designed and built by 1 dude with no prior experience. I would rank it 5 stars.
